extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark and automated evaluation paradigm for visual code generation
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is curated from expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots. Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items, prioritizing dynamics.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Web Scraping
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection includes 1,825 executable queries across nine primary topics: Game Development, SVG Generation, Web Applications, Simulations, Data Science, Management Systems, Multimedia Editing, Quick Tools, and Others.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Tasks are stratified into Easy/Medium/Hard tiers for discriminative evaluation. Each query is paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The annotations are created by a Multimodal LLM (MLLM)-as-Judge, which is rigorously guided by a fine-grained, per-task checklist to ensure holistic and reproducible scoring.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The checklist generation involves LLM-drafting and human-refining for specificity and screenability. A 10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achieves Cohen’s κ≥0.8 among annotators.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: The evaluation utilizes two referees: Gemini-2.5-Pro and Qwen2.5-VL-72B.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The benchmark aims to accelerate the development of user-centric generative models and provide a scalable and accurate tool for the community.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The current methodology evaluates dynamic behavior by capturing and analyzing a sequence of screenshots at fixed intervals. Future work could explore more sophisticated dynamic analysis techniques.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset use cases include Training, Testing, Validation, and Fine Tuning.
